CodeGen+OMNI nets +2.0pp (73.8% vs 71.8%) over 347 comparable assertions. OMNI wins 47 (saves drafts to the Drafts folder, disambiguates); CodeGen wins 40 — but 32 of those are empty / uncaptured OMNI replies on heavy compound tasks (Calendar OOO, Rules), not quality losses. 51 both-fail (folder-delete unsupported, compound multi-step).

78 of 466 assertions failed in BOTH control and experiment across 37 queries. Root causes: 69% model/agent behavior (HITL confirmation gaps + capability refusals), 23% missing data (empty mailbox), 8% bad assertions (false negatives).
